message:
test(standby): the pinned test host can refuse ONE episode's activation, so the APK's fallback runs for real; its marker gated out of releases (keepalive-r2 e, Codex ka_e r3 decision 2)

TEST BUILD ONLY (REMOTE60_PINNED_SELECT_TEST_SEAM): fail_activation_once=<token> in the pinned test
host's fault file refuses the NEXT StandbyActivate as an unknown entry -- the existing
kUdpStandbyStatusUnknown answer an expired entry gets -- once per token, logged with the token,
entry and generation ("[pinned-select-test] fault: fail_activation applied ..."). The table is not
touched; a later activation and every ordinary Hello are unaffected. The check sits at the top of
standby_handle's StandbyActivate branch under the seam define; the fault reader is header-only so
the seam-built unit test calls the same code.

The release gate (gnlink_check_fixed_server.py) now refuses 'pinned-select-test' and
'REMOTE60_PINNED_TEST_': the pinned host scanned as GNLinkStream.exe fails, the product
GNLinkStream.exe passes (0 markers); self-test 57/57.

Test: host_standby_activation_fault_test 17/17 x3 (no file / empty / other faults only: accepted;
armed: refused once, logged, table untouched; same token: accepted; a Hello untouched; a new token:
once more; a malformed token: none), its fault file in the repo scratch root. host_standby_table
56/56 x3. Nothing run against a host or the AVD.
